title: Amazon plans to spend $1B+ over five years for infrastructure upgrades and other projects in US communities that host its data centers, amid a growing backlash (Todd Bishop/GeekWire)
summary: Todd Bishop / GeekWire: Amazon plans to spend $1B+ over five years for infrastructure upgrades and other projects in US communities that host its data centers, amid a growing backlash — Amazon says it will spend more than $1 billion over five years in the U.S. communities where it builds and operates data centers …
